llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于增材制造Ti-6Al-4V中马氏体滑移与孪晶的晶界视角，虽未直接提供力学性能数据，但其微观结构分析对理解疲劳行为有重要参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not present mechanical or fatigue data; it is a microstructure study without experimental mechanical characterization or modeling of mechanical properties.

summary_zh.method: 采用晶界分析及微观结构表征方法。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了两种马氏体在晶界处的形成机制与变体选择规律。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates slip and twin martensite in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V from a grain boundary perspective.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization and grain boundary analysis are employed.
summary_en.result: Distinct formation mechanisms and variant selection of slip and twin martensite at grain boundaries are revealed.
summary_en.validation: No explicit validation is reported; the findings are based on microstructural observations.

papers.title: Interfacial characteristics and strengthening mechanisms of novel copper-interlayered Ti-6Al-4V wire-reinforced aluminum matrix composites
papers.abstract: The 5xxx series aluminum alloys are widely used in industry due to their excellent weldability and corrosion resistance. However, their relatively low tensile strength (240–400 MPa), compared to 2xxx (410–510 MPa) and 7xxx series alloys (570–690 MPa), restricts their application in high-stress environments. To address the mechanical property limitations of 5052 aluminum alloy, a novel strategy combining copper electroplating, gradient thermal processing, and hot-dip metal mold casting was developed to fabricate copper-interlayered Ti-6Al-4V wire-reinforced aluminum matrix composites (Cu-TC4/AMC). Quantitative analysis shows that Cu-TC4/AMC treated at 860 °C for 45 minutes exhibits a 91.9% and 22.6% increase in strength compared to the aluminum matrix and conventional composites, respectively. The copper buffer layer significantly alters interfacial evolution by suppressing Al-Ti interdiffusion through a kinetic barrier effect and redistributing stress due to its ductility. The multiscale interfacial design, achieved through controlled electrodeposition and non-isothermal sintering, addresses the longstanding trade-off between reinforcement efficiency and interfacial embrittlement in titanium-aluminum systems. These findings are supported by X-ray diffraction and EBSD analysis.This work demonstrates an innovative strategy for balancing strength and ductility in aluminum matrix composites, offering new insights into interfacial design for high-performance structural materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V作为增强体，但主要研究对象是铝基复合材料，与增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学和疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not study additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it investigates aluminum matrix composites reinforced with Ti-6Al-4V wires via casting, not AM processes like LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED, and the mechanical performance is of the composite, not of Ti-6Al-4V itself.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高5052铝镁合金的强度，以应对高应力环境需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用铜电镀、梯度热处理和热浸金属模铸造制备铜夹层Ti-6Al-4V丝增强铝基复合材料。
summary_zh.result: 860°C处理45分钟的复合材料强度比铝基体提高91.9%，比传统复合材料提高22.6%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试、X射线衍射和EBSD分析验证界面特性和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the mechanical properties of 5052 aluminum alloy for high-stress applications.
summary_en.method: Copper electroplating, gradient thermal processing, and hot-dip metal mold casting were used to fabricate copper-interlayered Ti-6Al-4V wire-reinforced aluminum matrix composites.
summary_en.result: The composite treated at 860°C for 45 minutes showed a 91.9% increase in strength over the aluminum matrix and a 22.6% increase over conventional composites.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, XRD, and EBSD analysis confirmed the interfacial evolution and strengthening mechanisms.
